notes: #1–#6 are not Bath: an imaginary Roman bath by Joli, Canaletto’s Knights of the Bath at Westminster, Fort Bath on the Scheldt, and Boulogne-sur-Mer bathing machines. #16 is Bath Row in Stamford. #14 (1966 panorama from Southdown) is genuine but faded, only 1280 px, and shows mostly suburbs with no clear landmarks; #13 is a vertical crop of the same scene. #8–#12 are photochroms of the Roman Baths and Abbey, all from the same decade as #7. #17 (Abbey from North Parade) and #15 (west front at dusk, higher resolution) are P6 alternatives.
